rule: producer launcher retains PID and exit status

substitute_invariants: terminal DONE line (printed only after the loop and the final atomic sentinel)
R2_SUBSTITUTE.PID_semantics: PID disappearance is NOT an exit-code substitute; it proves only that the producer is no longer writing output

GATE_ORDER: STABLE-OUTPUT guard: digest+size read twice, must match

DURABILITY_AUTHORITY.authority: the output DATABASE, re-opened and reconciled by the gate
DURABILITY_AUTHORITY.reason: the producer writes FINISHED=True BEFORE out.close(), so the sentinel alone does not prove the output is flushed

ACCEPTANCE_BINDING: acceptance refuses (ACCEPT_R2_REFUSED.json, non-zero exit) if FINAL_COMPLETE.json is absent or the output DB digest differs from the certified one
